_meta.note: Pinned provider prices per million tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute-TTL write premium rate (Anthropic bills cache writes at 1.25x input INSTEAD of the input rate; cache reads at 0.1x). OpenRouter/OpenAI-style providers report cached tokens inside prompt_tokens (prompt_includes_cache_read: true); Kimi K3 lists no cache discount or write premium on OpenRouter, so cache reads re-price at the input rate (no-op) and cache_write is 0 to avoid double-charging writes already counted in prompt_tokens. A counted round must re-capture this file at freeze time; every run record carries its sha256.

sources.anthropic: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing (Sonnet 5 pinned at the introductory $2/$10 rate, effective through 2026-08-31 - re-pin after that date)
